_howto: The shape Claude must return. The API route adds `original` (the parts that were sent) before returning it to the page.

parts.description: The rewritten text, one entry per part, using the part names that were sent (e.g. Label, Help text, Error text).

flags.description: Problems the model can't fix without more context, e.g. missing recovery step.

suggestedComponent.description: A different component the text should use, e.g. Alert instead of an error Toast. Null when the current component is right.
